sloka: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल हित्वैतद्दारुणं व्रतम् ।पुरवर्य्यामित: क्षिप्रमयोध्यां याहि राघव ॥ २.१११.१८॥
transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla hitvaitaddāruṇaṁ vratam ।puravaryyāmita: kṣipramayodhyāṁ yāhi rāghava ॥ 2.111.18॥

translations.english: O Bharata, O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghu race give up this formidable vow. Arise and quickly return to Ayodhya, the best of cities.
